q1_issues.issue: The modifier genus (Inheritance third_year_apprentice third_year) exposes a noun-headed time modifier that fails the predication test (*"the apprentice is third-year"), which *Compound concepts* bars exactly as night_shift is not night and "assistant secretary" keeps only its head genus, and the exposed symbol third_year is not a single-word lemma as decompose-once-to-single-word-lemmas requires.

q2_gaps: an ordinal + time-span attributive marking a stage or rank ("a third-year apprentice", "a first-year student") — compound fusion carries the kind, but nothing records that the apprenticeship is in its third year: Ordinal ranks the entity itself within a class, and Measure needs a magnitude on a stated dimension
notes: The copular routing is right otherwise — individual subject → Member on the fused compound kind, head genus (Inheritance third_year_apprentice apprentice) emitted, one Name atom, present tense so no status wrapper, and definitional 1.0/0.99 truth values throughout.
